required_action: Initial inspection: Within 18 months or 6,000 flight cycles after the effective date, whichever occurs first.
Inspection method: Detailed visual inspection (DVI) and high-frequency eddy current (HFEC) inspection of the wing front spar lower chord at WBL 160, left and right wings.
Repetitive inspections: Every 3,000 flight cycles after initial inspection.
If cracking is found: Repair using Boeing-approved repair method within 30 flight cycles of discovery. Contact Boeing for repair data.
Requests for alternative methods of compliance must be submitted to the Manager, Seattle ACO Branch, FAA, at sean.williams@faa.gov or (206) 231-3500.
